description: c038 activation gate: proves the multi-sample capsule sweep pipeline is LIVE on the player movement path. Boot to STAGE_CITRAINING via --skip-intro, teleport player 0 to the canonical CITRAINING spawn (637.0, 360.0, 923.0, room 16) via --debug-spawn-at. CITRAINING opens with a brief cutscene then drops into agent_select + Main Menu IMC overlays. Same dismiss flow as vehicle_flow: ACTION_USE at 25s to accept agent_select, ACTION_CANCEL_USE at 28s to close Main Menu, by 32s the player is in free-roam (lvIsPaused 1->0, gameplay IMC active). Then fire ACTION_JUMP taps. Each jump produces a positive verticalDelta in bwalkUpdateVertical; with PC_CAPSULE_ENABLED=1 that delta flows through capsuleSweep, which emits 'CAPSULE: sweep enter ...' on entry and 'CAPSULE: sweep result=CLEAR|BLOCKED ...' on completion. Required-Patterns assert: (1) capsule pipeline activates; (2) sweep returns a real result. This smoke remains activation coverage, not a repro-grade bad-surface assertion. Add a coordinate-specific smoke when Mike captures the known angled-ceiling/table-top repro location.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --skip-intro -> STAGE_CITRAINING (0x26). --debug-spawn-at parses (637.0,360.0,923.0,16) and arms the one-shot latch. setupCreateProps consumes the latch within ~7s of boot.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_USE
input_sequence.comment: agent_select accept -- focus-independent injection. Pattern lifted from vehicle_flow.json:27. Accepts the default load-agent option.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_CANCEL_USE
input_sequence.comment: close Main Menu -> CI free-roam (lvIsPaused 1 -> 0). Pattern lifted from vehicle_flow.json:28. By 32s the gameplay IMC is active and allowc1buttons is non-zero, enabling player movement.
settle past the menu dismiss; gameplay IMC fully active, bondmove tick reading ACTION_AXIS_MOVE / ACTION_JUMP from player 0.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_JUMP
input_sequence.comment: jump #1 -- bondmove c1buttonsthisframe |= BUTTON_JUMP -> wantsjump=true -> bwalkUpdateVertical applies FIXED_JUMP_IMPULSE=8.2 to bdeltapos.y -> next tick the airborne branch (vv_manground > vv_ground at bondwalk.c:1205) fires, computes positive verticalDelta, and capsuleSweep emits CAPSULE: sweep enter + result.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_JUMP
input_sequence.comment: jump #2 -- spacing 2.5s lets the previous jump's full arc resolve (ascent ~0.5s, apex, descent ~0.7s).

input_sequence.name: ACTION_JUMP
input_sequence.comment: jump #4 -- four scripted jumps push the sweep count well above the >=2 floor.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_JUMP
input_sequence.comment: jump #5 -- final jump; landing settles by ~47s.
settle for >=10s of post-jump tick to capture late CAPSULE_CEIL_CLAMP / JUMP_COLLIDED markers from a delayed clamp resolution.

scripted exit -- by 90s the capsule + bondwalk pipeline has had ~60s of post-spawn ticks (including cutscene + menu dismiss + 5 scripted jumps). If the pipeline regressed (AV / hang / wrong-branch), it would have surfaced before this point.

required_lines: LOAD: lv\.c entering stage load sequence for stagenum=0x26
BOOT: --debug-spawn-at consumed: prop=(?:0x)?[0-9a-fA-F]+ stagenum=0x26 result=OK pos=\(637\.\d+,360\.\d+,923\.\d+\) room=16
CAPSULE: sweep enter start=\([^\)]+\) move=\([^\)]+\) radius=

required_counts.comment: Five scripted ACTION_JUMP taps each produce a positive verticalDelta in bwalkUpdateVertical (airborne branch at bondwalk.c:1205). With PC_CAPSULE_ENABLED=1 (Track G, 2026-05-15) the verticalDelta flows through capsuleSweep at bondwalk.c:1255, which emits CAPSULE: sweep enter ... on entry (capsule.c:74). One jump produces multiple enters (one per airborne tick during ascent + descent). >=2 is the conservative floor; healthy runs see 10+ enters. <2 means the sweep is not firing -- either PC_CAPSULE_ENABLED reverted to 0, the cutscene/menu IMC never released, or the jump action did not flow through to bondwalk.

Mirror-pairing for the enter assertion: every enter must be matched by a result. CLEAR is the dominant case (open-air ascent on CITRAINING's main floor); BLOCKED appears if any ceiling/wall intersects the sweep volume (radius * sub-step). >=2 results paired with >=2 enters proves the sweep loop ran to completion at least twice -- confirms capsule.c:160 or capsule.c:170 emitted the result line.
